common.name: Name
common.noResults: Nothing to show for this selection.

chartOfAccounts.title: Chart of Accounts
chartOfAccounts.subtitle: Every account the general ledger can post to.
chartOfAccounts.countLabel: {count, plural, =0 {No accounts} one {# account} other {# accounts}}
chartOfAccounts.emptyHint: The chart of accounts is seeded when the organisation is provisioned. If this is empty, accounting has not been set up.
chartOfAccounts.controlAccountHint: Control account — only the posting engine may write to it.
chartOfAccounts.versionNote: Name, class and hierarchy come from the account's current version. An account's code and normal balance never change; everything else is versioned.

periods.title: Fiscal Periods
periods.subtitle: Accounting periods and the fiscal years they belong to.
periods.empty: No fiscal year has been created.
periods.emptyHint: Creating a fiscal year generates its twelve accounting periods automatically.
periods.periodCount: {count, plural, =0 {No periods} one {# period} other {# periods}}

statusHint.CLOSED: Rejects all postings. Reports read from the frozen snapshot.
statusHint.REOPENED: Accepts postings again. Downstream snapshots were invalidated.

periods.managementUnavailable: Locking, closing and reopening periods are not available in this build.
periods.managementUnavailableHint: The endpoints exist but have no authorization — any signed-in user could close a fiscal year. Raised as issue #25.

journals.title: Journals
journals.subtitle: Manual general-ledger entries.
journals.emptyHint: A manual journal records an entry the operational modules do not produce — an accrual, a correction, an opening adjustment.
journals.clientFilterNote: Filtered in the browser — the API returns every journal.
journals.countLabel: {count, plural, =0 {No journals} one {# journal} other {# journals}}

journalForm.title: New journal
journalForm.accountingDateHint: Must fall inside an open period.
journalForm.documentDateHint: Optional. Defaults to the accounting date.
journalForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Why this entry is being raised
journalForm.linesHint: At least two lines. Each line carries either a debit or a credit, never both.
journalForm.postingBlockedAccount: This account does not accept manual postings.

errors.tooFewLines: A journal needs at least two lines.
errors.lineNeedsAmount: Every line needs a debit or a credit.
errors.lineBothAmounts: A line cannot carry both a debit and a credit.
errors.lineAmountNegative: Enter a positive amount. Use the other column to reverse the direction.
errors.outOfBalance: Debits and credits must be equal. Currently out by {difference}.

journalDetail.outOfBalanceWarning: This journal's debits and credits do not agree — {debit} against {credit}. The server rejects an unbalanced journal at posting, so it cannot be posted as it stands.

actions.heading: Actions
actions.failed: The action could not be completed.
actions.noneAvailable: No action is available from this status.

confirm.submitBody: It becomes read-only until it is approved or rejected.
confirm.approveBody: It can then be posted to the general ledger.
confirm.rejectBody: Say why, so whoever raised it can correct it.
confirm.postTitle: Post this journal to the ledger?
confirm.postBody: Posting is permanent. A posted journal can only be undone by a reversal, which leaves both entries on the record.
confirm.reverseBody: A new entry is raised with the debits and credits swapped. Neither entry is removed.

trialBalance.title: Trial Balance
trialBalance.subtitle: Opening, movement and closing balances for every account.
trialBalance.loadFailed: Could not generate the trial balance.
trialBalance.includeZero: Include accounts with a zero closing balance
trialBalance.empty: No account carries a balance at this date.
trialBalance.emptyHint: Nothing has been posted on or before this date, or every account nets to zero.
trialBalance.notBalancedHint: Closing debits of {debit} do not equal closing credits of {credit}. A trial balance that does not balance means the ledger has an entry that should not exist — this is not a rounding matter.
trialBalance.snapshotNote: A closed period is read from its frozen snapshot rather than recomputed.

profitLoss.title: Profit & Loss
profitLoss.subtitle: Revenue, cost of sales and expenses over a date range.
profitLoss.loadFailed: Could not generate the profit and loss report.
profitLoss.empty: Nothing was posted in this range.
profitLoss.emptyHint: Raise and post a journal, or widen the dates.
profitLoss.sectionEmpty: No account in this section carries an amount.
profitLoss.closingExcludedNote: Year-end closing entries are excluded, so a closed year still reports the income it earned.
